text.p: The remains of T.D. 34W may cause additional heavy showers and local flash flooding over the Malay Peninsula. This system will be watched for redevelopment as it enters the Andaman Sea in the eastern Bay of Bengal.
Tropical Cyclone 05A will dissipate in 24 hours east of northern Somalia in the Arabian Sea. The threat to shipping will decrease.
Tropical Cyclone 05S, near 10s/95e in the Indian Ocean, will continue to move slowly to the west, threatening shipping, as top winds increase to near 45 mph this period.
There are no further statements at this time.
